blocks.task_summary: Find the number of ways to arrange 9 team members (6 boys, 3 girls) in a line when (i) there are no restrictions, and (ii) the three girls must be placed next to each other.
method_path: Treat 3 girls as a single block: 7! arrangements of 7 objects
Multiply by 3! for internal arrangements of the girls

evidence.basis: (a)(i): A1 for 9! = 362880. Note: Accept 9! or 363000. (a)(ii): (M1) attempt to consider girls as a single object, A1 for 7! x 3! = 30240. Note: Accept 30200.

blocks.task_summary: Find the number of possible selections of 5 members that contain at least two girls.
method_path: Recognise two cases: exactly 2 girls or exactly 3 girls

evidence.basis: METHOD 1: (M1) recognition of two cases; (A1) 2 girls C(6,3)xC(3,2)=60, 3 girls C(6,2)xC(3,3)=15; A1 total 75. METHOD 2: (M1) recognition of total minus 0 or 1 girl; (A1) total C(9,5)=126, one girl C(3,1)xC(6,4)=45, no girls C(6,5)=6; A1 126-45-6=75.
